research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free matching of two contextual prerequisites to already-present mathematical meanings; no new definitions, no original-source edits and no human certification.

resolutions.review_rationale: The differential-operator formulation requires D:M→N to preserve addition and R-scalar multiplication after restricting S-module scalars along R→S. The independent existing module-linear map formulation precisely states these two equations for left R-modules. No S-linearity, differential order condition or universal module of principal parts is implied by this prerequisite match.

The coefficient-ring source uses the residue characteristic p defined as the characteristic of the quotient field R/m of the local ring (R,m). The independent existing characteristic-of-a-field definition gives exactly this characteristic after selecting F=R/m. The residue-field construction and coefficient-ring compatibility Λ∩m=pΛ remain additional source-specific requirements, and characteristic(R) need not equal characteristic(R/m).
